text: dsh-stock-ticker 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 A 股行情插件，在界面叠加可拖动的自选股迷你窗口，并提供独立设置页管理列表。它通过 shell.overlay 显示行情与分时曲线，通过 settings.section 提供证券搜索、自选股增删排序及显示设置。悬停可查看价格、涨跌幅和更多行情详情；宿主端代理东方财富行情接口，并在请求失败时保留可用数据。适合希望在 DSH 工作界面同时查看 A 股自选行情的用户。插件无需配置 API Key，但会连接东方财富接口获取报价、曲线和证券搜索结果。

dsh-stock-ticker adds a draggable A-share watchlist panel to the DSH web client, showing quotes, intraday charts, and hover details. Its settings page searches securities and manages the list and display options. It fetches market and search data from Eastmoney; no API key is configured.
想在 DSH 页面边工作边看 A 股自选行情。
有没有能显示股票分时曲线和涨跌信息的小窗口？
dsh-stock-ticker 的功能「自选行情窗口」：在 DSH 网页 shell.overlay 显示可拖动的自选列表、报价与分时曲线；悬停行可查看详细行情。
dsh-stock-ticker 的功能「自选股设置」：通过 settings.section 页面搜索证券，并添加、排序或移除自选项，还可调整曲线数量、刷新间隔和窗口显示。
dsh-stock-ticker 使用东方财富报价、历史分时和证券搜索接口；证券代码及搜索词会用于外部请求，行情由这些服务返回。

dsh-stock-ticker README · The mini-window：One draggable, collapsible panel in the `shell.overlay` seat, showing every watched instrument.
Rows inside the configured curve budget draw an intraday 分时 curve; hovering a row opens its full
detail card — open/high/low/previous close, volume, turnover, turnover rate, amplitude, volume
ratio, market cap, float cap, P/E/P/B, and the limit-up / limit-down prices — without reflowing the
list underneath the pointer.

dsh-stock-ticker README · The mini-window：**Placement is two separate acts.** Dragging the title bar moves the panel and keeps it there for
the session. The tack in the header is what makes a position durable, and while a panel is pinned
it is **locked**: the header stops being a drag handle (the grab cursor goes away) and attempts to
move it do nothing. Press the tack again to unlock — the panel stays exactly where it is and becomes
draggable again — or use the settings page to clear the pin.

dsh-stock-ticker README · The mini-window：The tack follows the durable pin only, so its label always says what pressing it will do: 钉住 while
the panel is free, 取消钉住 while it is pinned. It never flips underneath a drag, which is what made
an earlier version look like it was jumping to the default corner.

dsh-stock-ticker README · The mini-window：- **A refused pin write does not move the panel.** The position is held locally until the section
  confirms it, so a Host that rejects the field (a half-updated deployment) leaves the panel where
  it was put. The control honestly reports that the pin did not stick, since a reload would lose the
  position.
- **A position saved on a larger window is corrected against the current one** before it is applied,
  so a resize can never strand the panel off screen where its only drag handle is unreachable.

dsh-stock-ticker README · The watchlist page：A `settings.section` page named 股票盯盘. Search by code or Chinese name, add, reorder, and remove
instruments, and set how many get a curve, the refresh cadence, the panel's opacity, and whether the
mini-window is shown at all.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Correct by default for A-shares：A rise is red and a fall is green, including the curve stroke — the convention a mainland reader
expects, not the Western one. This carries dedicated regression coverage because it was a reported
defect.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | A desktop build whose web GUI serves `window.__DSH_BOOT__` and exposes the `shell.overlay` / `settings.section` extension seats |
| Node.js | `>= 20.3` (the host half uses `AbortSignal.any`) |
| Runtime dependencies | **None** |
| Network | Outbound HTTPS to `push2.eastmoney.com`, `push2his.eastmoney.com`, and `searchapi.eastmoney.com` |

dsh-stock-ticker README · Requirements：> The plugin targets mainland China A-share markets (Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing). It is not a
> general-purpose quote client for other exchanges.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Installing straight from GitHub：Because the package has no build step and no dependencies, a clone works as-is:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/f1426912008/dsh-stock-ticker.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-stock-ticker
```

dsh-stock-ticker README · Installing by hand：A profile whose composition the app does not manage yet can equivalently take the loader row by hand
in its `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: stock-ticker
      name: dsh-stock-ticker
```

The package has **no runtime dependencies** — not even the harness's schema library — so a row that
names an absolute path works too:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: stock-ticker
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-stock-ticker/src/index.js'
```

dsh-stock-ticker README · Configuration：The durable section is resolved through the best backing the running composition offers:

| Backing | When it is chosen | Where the values live |
|---|---|---|
| settings namespace | the settings service exposes `register(namespace, schema)` | the platform's own settings document, under `stock-ticker:` |
| JSON document | otherwise (the normal case on the 0.2 line) | `$DSH_HOME/stock-ticker.json`, mode `0600` |
| process memory | a read-only harness home | for the session only |

dsh-stock-ticker README · Configuration：The browser half never touches the settings RPC. The Host's Web settings surface serves an allowlist
of in-box namespaces, so an out-of-tree namespace answers `settings-not-exposed`; configuration
therefore travels over this plugin's own `/api/stock-ticker/config` route, and the settings page and
the mini-window are two views of one shared mirror.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Settings fields：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `watchlist` | `[]` | Instruments, in display order. At most 24. |
| `maxCurves` | `6` | How many rows get an intraday curve (1–24). |
| `refreshMs` | `15000` | Poll cadence during trading hours (5000–300000). |
| `visible` | `true` | Whether the panel is mounted. |
| `opacity` | `1` | Panel opacity, `0.35`–`1`. |
| `pinned` | `null` | `{ left, top }` once the panel has been placed. |

dsh-stock-ticker README · Settings fields：Each watchlist entry is `{ code, name, market }`, where `code` is six digits and `market` is one of
`sh`, `sz`, `bj`.

Writes are **strict**: an unknown key or a wrongly-typed value is refused with `400` rather than
silently merged, because a silently-dropped field looks to the user like a save that did not stick.

dsh-stock-ticker README · HTTP routes：All routes are same-origin under `/api/stock-ticker`.

| Route | Body | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /config` | — | the resolved section |
| `PATCH /config` | a partial section | the next section; `400` on an invalid field |
| `POST /quotes` | `{ secids? }` | `{ asOf, trading, throttled, quotes }`; defaults to the watchlist |
| `POST /trends` | `{ secid, ndays? }` | `{ points, previousClose, name }` |
| `POST /search` | `{ query }` | `{ results }` |
dsh-stock-ticker README · HTTP routes：Request bodies are capped at 4 KB, and every symbol argument must match `^(sh|sz|bj)\d{6}$`.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Data source and rate limiting：Quotes come from East Money's public push2 endpoints, read from the host process only: a page cannot
set the `Referer` that provider requires, and keeping the traffic host-side is what makes one cache
serve every tab.

Prices arrive as scaled integers (`f59` is the scale for the whole row, percentage fields included)
and are normalized in `src/provider.js`, which is the only module that knows that wire format.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Data source and rate limiting：| Concern | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Quote cache | 8 s while the exchanges are open, 120 s outside those hours |
| Curve cache | 30 s |
| Search cache | 300 s |
| In-flight dedup | Concurrent misses share one upstream request per key |
| Upstream concurrency | Capped at 3 reads at a time |
| Transport retries | 2 attempts, 400 ms backoff, transport noise only |
| Cooldown | After 4 consecutive transport failures, stop asking for 45 s |

dsh-stock-ticker README · Data source and rate limiting：The quote response carries `throttled` while the provider is in that cooldown, and the mini-window
turns it into 行情源限流 · 显示最后数据 — keeping the last known numbers on screen rather than replacing
them with an apology. The defaults (15 s cadence, 5 s floor) are set for that same reason: this
provider throttles clients that ask often.

Failures are never cached, so the next poll retries immediately rather than being told the market is
broken for the whole TTL window.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Architecture：```
src/index.js      host plugin body
src/routes.js     the JSON routes and their request validation
src/provider.js   the upstream quote wire format, isolated
src/settings.js   section shape, defaults, and the one write validator

dsh-stock-ticker README · Architecture：`lib/client.js` is hand-authored in the loader's factory form rather than compiled, so the package
ships no build step. It depends on nothing but the platform seed modules (`react` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), and it resolves those defensively: every glyph is drawn
inline and the two primitives fall back to native elements, so a renamed or removed export degrades
one control instead of aborting the bundle.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Architecture：For the design reasoning behind the backing selection, the caching layer, and the transport
policy, see [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

dsh-stock-ticker README · Why there is no build step：The harness's schema library is a peer of the harness rather than of a plugin, so a plugin installed
outside the harness's own module tree cannot resolve it. Carrying a hand-written validator keeps this
package installable anywhere — an absolute-path Loader row included — and free of version skew
against the harness's schema release.
section: Why there is no build step

text:
dsh-stock-ticker README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/f1426912008/dsh-stock-ticker.git
cd dsh-stock-ticker
npm run check     # syntax-check every source file, no dependencies required
```

There is nothing to install and nothing to build. See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the
full workflow, the code style, and the manual test matrix that covers both halves end-to-end.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Layout of the two halves：The host half is read from disk when the DSH **process** starts; the browser half is read when the
**page** loads. Either can therefore outlive the code on disk, which is why both carry a build stamp
(see below).

dsh-stock-ticker README · Troubleshooting a stale build：A mismatch between the two halves looks like a feature that "does not work" rather than a deployment
problem. The settings page footer prints both stamps so this is never a guess:

```
前端 2026-09-30.6 · 宿主 2026-09-30.6
```

dsh-stock-ticker README · Troubleshooting a stale build：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **宿主 unknown** | The running Host half predates the stamp | Restart DSH |
| **宿主 older than 前端** | The Host is running an older build than the page | Restart DSH |
| **前端 older than the stamp in this repo** | The page is running a previously served bundle | Hard-reload the page |

dsh-stock-ticker README · Troubleshooting a stale build：`HOST_BUILD` in `src/settings.js` and `CLIENT_BUILD` in `lib/client.js` are bumped whenever the
respective half's behaviour changes, so the stamps always identify the build that produced them.

dsh-stock-ticker README · Known limitations：- **Quote data is not attributed or licensed for redistribution.** The plugin reads a public
  endpoint intended for a browser page; use it for personal monitoring.
- **A market session is approximated.** Trading hours are computed from Beijing time and weekdays
  only, so an exchange holiday costs a few extra upstream requests rather than correctness — the flag
  only drives a cache TTL and the refresh cadence.
- **The watchlist is capped at 24 instruments**, which is also the per-request ceiling.
- **Rows outside the curve budget fetch their curve on hover**, so the first hover on such a row
  shows its price cells before its card's chart fills in.
- **No pinned-session or multi-workspace scoping**: the overlay is root-scoped, so the watchlist is
  the same in every session.
- **The upstream provider blocks eager clients.** Polling it from one address at a multi-second
  cadence gets that address throttled for a while, independently of this plugin. The cooldown limits
  how much the plugin contributes to that, but cannot make the provider more permissive; when it does
  block, the panel says so and keeps showing the last values it recei

dsh-stock-ticker README · 迷你窗口：位于 `shell.overlay` 座位上的一个可拖拽、可折叠面板，逐行显示自选股。处于曲线预算内的行会绘制
分时曲线；鼠标悬停某一行会打开它的完整详情卡 —— 今开/最高/最低/昨收、成交量、成交额、换手率、
振幅、量比、总市值、流通市值、市盈率/市净率，以及涨停价 / 跌停价 —— 并且**不会**让指针下方的
列表发生重排。

**「摆放」和「固定」是两件独立的事。** 拖动标题栏会移动面板，并且仅在本次会话内保留位置。
标题栏上的图钉才是让位置持久化的动作；面板处于固定状态时它是**锁定**的：标题栏不再是拖拽手柄
（抓取光标消失），尝试移动不会有任何效果。再次点击图钉即可解锁 —— 面板停在原地并重新可拖拽 ——
或者在设置页清除固定。

图钉只跟随**持久化的固定状态**，因此它的文案始终说明「按下去会发生什么」：面板自由时显示
钉住，已固定时显示 取消钉住。它绝不会在拖拽过程中翻转，而那正是早期版本看起来像「跳到默认
角落」的原因。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 迷你窗口：- **固定写入被拒绝时，面板不会移动。** 位置会先在本地保留，直到配置段确认写入成功；因此当 Host
  拒绝该字段时（例如部署只更新了一半），面板会停在用户放置的位置。控件会如实报告固定没有生效，
  因为重新加载后位置就会丢失。
- **在更大窗口上保存的位置会先按当前窗口校正**，再被应用，所以改变窗口大小绝不会把面板甩到屏幕
  外，导致它唯一的拖拽手柄无法触及。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 自选股设置页：一个名为 股票盯盘 的 `settings.section` 页面。可按代码或中文名搜索、添加、排序、删除标的，并可
设置多少行绘制曲线、刷新频率、面板不透明度，以及是否显示迷你窗口。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 默认符合 A 股习惯：涨为红、跌为绿，曲线描边同理 —— 这是内地读者预期的约定，而非欧美习惯。该行为有专门的回归测试，
因为它曾是一个被上报的缺陷。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 直接从 GitHub 安装：由于本包没有构建步骤也没有依赖，直接克隆即可使用：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/f1426912008/dsh-stock-ticker.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-stock-ticker
```

dsh-stock-ticker README · 手工安装：对于应用尚未接管其组合的 profile，也可以直接在它的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中手工添加 loader 行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: stock-ticker
      name: dsh-stock-ticker
```

本包**没有任何运行时依赖** —— 连 harness 的 schema 库都不依赖 —— 因此用绝对路径指定入口文件的
行同样可行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: stock-ticker
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-stock-ticker/src/index.js'
```

dsh-stock-ticker README · 配置：持久化配置段会按当前组合能提供的最佳后端来解析：

| 后端 | 选择时机 | 数据位置 |
|---|---|---|
| settings 命名空间 | settings 服务暴露 `register(namespace, schema)` | 平台自身的设置文档，位于 `stock-ticker:` 下 |
| JSON 文档 | 其它情况（0.2 线上的常规路径） | `$DSH_HOME/stock-ticker.json`，权限 `0600` |
| 进程内存 | harness home 只读时 | 仅当前会话有效 |

浏览器端从不接触 settings RPC。Host 的 Web 设置界面只服务白名单内的内置命名空间，因此树外命名
空间会返回 `settings-not-exposed`；配置因而经由本插件自己的 `/api/stock-ticker/config` 路由传输，
设置页与迷你窗口是同一份共享镜像的两个视图。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 设置字段：| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `watchlist` | `[]` | 自选标的，按显示顺序排列，最多 24 个 |
| `maxCurves` | `6` | 多少行绘制分时曲线（1–24） |
| `refreshMs` | `15000` | 交易时段的轮询间隔（5000–300000） |
| `visible` | `true` | 是否挂载面板 |
| `opacity` | `1` | 面板不透明度，`0.35`–`1` |
| `pinned` | `null` | 面板放置后为 `{ left, top }` |

每个自选标的条目形如 `{ code, name, market }`，其中 `code` 为六位数字，`market` 为 `sh`、`sz`
或 `bj` 之一。

写入是**严格校验**的：未知字段或类型错误的取值会以 `400` 拒绝，而不是被静默合并 —— 因为被静默
丢弃的字段在用户看来就是「保存没生效」。

dsh-stock-ticker README · HTTP 路由：所有路由均为同源，位于 `/api/stock-ticker` 下。

| 路由 | 请求体 | 返回 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /config` | — | 解析后的配置段 |
| `PATCH /config` | 部分配置段 | 下一个配置段；字段非法时返回 `400` |
| `POST /quotes` | `{ secids? }` | `{ asOf, trading, throttled, quotes }`；缺省使用自选股列表 |
| `POST /trends` | `{ secid, ndays? }` | `{ points, previousClose, name }` |
| `POST /search` | `{ query }` | `{ results }` |

请求体上限为 4 KB，每个标的参数都必须匹配 `^(sh|sz|bj)\d{6}$`。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 数据源与限流：行情来自东方财富公开的 push2 系列接口，且只在宿主进程中读取：页面无法设置该数据源要求的
`Referer` 头，而把流量留在宿主侧才能让一份缓存服务所有标签页。

价格以缩放整数形式下发（`f59` 是整行的缩放比例，百分比字段同样适用），并在 `src/provider.js`
中归一化 —— 它是唯一了解该线上格式的模块。

| 关注点 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 行情缓存 | 开市时 8 秒，非交易时段 120 秒 |
| 分时曲线缓存 | 30 秒 |
| 搜索缓存 | 300 秒 |
| 并发去重 | 并发未命中共享同一个上游请求（按 key） |
| 上游并发 | 同时最多 3 个读取 |
| 传输重试 | 2 次尝试，400 ms 退避，且仅针对传输抖动 |
| 冷却 | 连续 4 次传输失败后，静默 45 秒不再请求 |

dsh-stock-ticker README · 数据源与限流：处于冷却期时，行情响应会带上 `throttled`，迷你窗口将其转为 行情源限流 · 显示最后数据 —— 保留
最后已知的数字，而不是用一句道歉把它们替换掉。默认值（15 秒间隔、5 秒下限）同样出于这个原因：
该数据源会限流请求过于频繁的客户端。

失败结果永远不会被缓存，因此下一次轮询会立即重试，而不是在整个 TTL 窗口内被告诉「市场坏了」。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 架构：```
src/index.js      宿主插件主体
src/routes.js     JSON 路由及其请求校验
src/provider.js   上游行情线上格式，隔离在此
src/settings.js   配置段形状、默认值与唯一的写入校验器

`lib/client.js` 是直接以 loader 工厂形式手写的，而非编译产物，因此本包不含构建步骤。它除了平台
种子模块（`react` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`）之外不依赖任何东西，并且以防御性
方式解析它们：所有图标均内联绘制，两个 primitive 会回退到原生元素，因此某个被改名或移除的导出
只会让一个控件降级，而不会让整个 bundle 中断。

关于后端选择、缓存层与传输策略背后的设计推理，见
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 为什么没有构建步骤：harness 的 schema 库是 harness 自身的 peer 依赖，而非插件的，因此安装在 harness 模块树之外的
插件无法解析它。自带一个手写校验器可以让本包安装到任何位置 —— 包括使用绝对路径的 Loader 行 ——
并且不会与 harness 的 schema 版本产生偏差。

git clone https://github.com/f1426912008/dsh-stock-ticker.git
cd dsh-stock-ticker

```

dsh-stock-ticker README · 两端的加载时机：宿主部分在 DSH **进程**启动时从磁盘读取；浏览器部分在**页面**加载时读取。因此任一端都可能比磁盘
上的代码活得更久 —— 这正是两端都带有构建戳记的原因（见下节）。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 排查「旧代码」问题：两端版本不一致时，表现出来的更像「某个功能坏了」，而不是部署问题。设置页页脚会打印两个戳记，
让这件事永远不需要靠猜：

```
前端 2026-09-30.6 · 宿主 2026-09-30.6
```

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| **宿主 unknown** | 正在运行的宿主部分早于戳记机制 | 重启 DSH |
| **宿主 早于 前端** | 宿主运行的是比页面更旧的构建 | 重启 DSH |
| **前端 早于本仓库中的戳记** | 页面运行的是此前提供的 bundle | 强制刷新页面 |

`src/settings.js` 中的 `HOST_BUILD` 与 `lib/client.js` 中的 `CLIENT_BUILD` 会在对应端行为变更时
一并提升，因此戳记始终能标识出产生它的那次构建。

dsh-stock-ticker README · 已知限制：- **行情数据未做归属声明，也未获得再分发许可。** 本插件读取的是面向浏览器页面的公开接口，请仅用于
  个人盯盘。
- **交易时段是近似判断的。** 交易时间仅按北京时间与工作日计算，因此遇到交易所休市只会多产生几次
  上游请求，而不会影响正确性 —— 该标志只用于驱动缓存 TTL 与刷新频率。
- **自选股上限为 24 个标的**，这也是单次请求的上限。
- **曲线预算之外的行在悬停时才拉取曲线**，因此这类行首次悬停时会先显示价格单元格，详情卡中的图表
  随后才填充。
- **没有按会话或工作区隔离**：overlay 是根作用域的，所以每个会话中的自选股都相同。
- **上游数据源会封锁过于频繁的客户端。** 从同一地址以数秒级频率轮询，会让该地址在一段时间内被限流，
  这与本插件无关。冷却机制限制了本插件对此的「贡献」，但无法让数据源变得更宽松；当它真的封锁时，
  面板会如实说明，并继续显示最后收到的数值。
- **详情卡文案跟随应用语言环境**，通过框架的翻译器解析，并以插件自带词典作为确定性回退；插件未
  提供的语言会回退到中文。
- **迷你窗口显示的一切都来自用户自己的配置**，不存在硬编码的可调项。
